module: Flowgraph module (moduleOrder 0) that manages custom buttons shown in the UI during a flowgraph project. Each button has a label, a style, an active state, an order, and clicked/complete variables stored in a variableStorage. In afterTrigger, the list of active buttons, sorted by order then id, is sent to the UI via guihooks.trigger('CustomFGButtons', data). The click comes back through a Lua command that calls buttonClicked.
notes: The 'clicked' variable is reset to false on every afterTrigger: it is true for only one tick.
The list is sent back to the UI only if buttonsChanged is true (add or set).
The module is called 'button' in mgr.modules (see getCmd).

getFreeId.desc: Increments and returns a button id.

init.desc: Creates the variableStorage and calls clear().

clear.desc: Clears variables and buttons, resets the id counter to 0 and sends an empty list to the UI (CustomFGButtons).

addButton.desc: Adds a button and returns its id.

data.desc: optional fields label (default 'Button <id>'), style (default 'default'), active (default true), order (default id)

getButton.desc: Returns the button's table (variable-type fields: label, style, active, order, clicked, complete).

set.desc: Changes a button field via the variableStorage (applied at the end of the tick) and marks the list as modified.

field.desc: label, style, active, order, clicked or complete

buttonClicked.desc: Called when the UI reports a click: sets clicked and complete to true.

getCmd.desc: Builds the Lua command string executed by the UI on click: gets the manager's 'button' module and calls buttonClicked(id).

afterTrigger.desc: Called after the graph tick: finalizes the variables, sends the sorted active buttons to the UI if modified, then sets clicked back to false.

executionStopped.desc: Called when the project stops: calls clear() (the buttons disappear from the UI).
